findings.message: _RA_V2_ESTATUS_KEY is initialised with two printf subprocess forks at module-load time; a string literal would avoid both forks on every source of this file.

The v2 envelope embed (lines 476-478) adds a third full jq read-parse-rewrite plus atomic_write tmpfile+rename cycle on out_json; folding it into the did_not_run pass at lines 462-469 would reduce that to two cycles.

The legacy discovery path now forks find and sort subprocesses where the removed _ra_collect_lenses_glob used a shell-internal nullglob expansion — zero subprocesses; only affects the legacy/test path, not production dispatch.

The interrupt handler writes JSON to disk via atomic_write then immediately re-reads it with cat to feed render_review_report_md; the content was available in-process and could be captured in a variable to avoid the extra read.
